market_gate.economic_buyer: Project finance, procurement, AI governance, or investment committee owner who controls review process or data access.
market_gate.painful_trigger: A committee or procurement review is due this month, but key project claims are not evidence-ready.
market_gate.current_workaround: Shared folders, spreadsheets, email threads, adviser notes, and manual committee memo review.
observed_evidence: No private buyer behavior is claimed by this synthetic example.
inference: Confidential project teams often need alias-safe evidence readiness before sharing material externally.
kill_criteria: No prospect provides even a redacted packet.
No second artifact is requested after a first profile.
No process owner corrects or adopts the workflow.

limitations: Summarizes demand but does not include signed customer evidence.
Provides delivery scope but omits export-control conditions and warranty terms.
Questions are available, but owner responses are not yet supplied.

claims.claim: ProjectCo has sufficient demand evidence for committee review.
claims.evidence_gap: No signed customer letter, term sheet, or redacted offtake evidence is included.
claims.risk_if_wrong: Committee memo may overstate revenue certainty.

claims.claim: Vendor-A can deliver the required system within the review timetable.
claims.evidence_gap: Delivery assumptions are present, but warranty, export-control, and supply-chain conditions are missing.
claims.risk_if_wrong: Procurement path may slip after committee approval.

claims.claim: The file is ready for Lender-1 diligence.
claims.evidence_gap: The lender question list exists, but answers, ownership, and evidence attachments are missing.
claims.risk_if_wrong: The review may enter lender diligence with unresolved blocking questions.

owner_actions.action: Provide redacted customer evidence or mark the demand claim as unsafe to repeat.
Request Vendor-A delivery conditions, warranty terms, and export-control assumptions.
Map each Lender-1 question to an owner, source item, and response status.

readiness.rationale: Demand and financing claims are not evidence-ready; vendor delivery is only partially supported.

boundary_notes: This profile does not approve or reject the project.
This profile does not provide legal, compliance, procurement, security, tax, customs, financial, insurance, sanctions, export-control, or investment advice.
This profile checks evidence readiness and owner actions using supplied or redacted source roles.
Factual truth, regulatory interpretation, technical due diligence, and investment decisions remain outside this artifact.

follow_up_signal.notes: Synthetic example only; no buyer traction is claimed.
